title: bus_client's never-beats proof pins reach itself and imports no device
intention: cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_a_client_reaches_and_never_beats.py tooth (i) imports four device modules to call their client helpers with the beat stubbed: codemother's watch (:80, :106) and seed_trees (:83), the librarian's live (:81) and intention_extractor's live (:82). A tool's proofs measure the tool (RULE 1). Every one of those helpers is a one-line reach('inference_domain'), and reach is bus_client's own.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: encapsulation_holds names cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_a_client_reaches_and_never_beats.py:80,81,82,83,106 (cairn.devices.codemother.watch, .librarian.live, .intention_extractor.live, .codemother.seed_trees). RULE 1: a component talks to another only through its public interface.
traces_to: CLAUDE.md RULE 1; outline 2.3.7.1 (a device's public interface is the bus plus any tool it publishes); outline 17.13.1.
how: test_a_client_reaches_and_never_beats.py tooth (i): with DeviceRoster.pulse stubbed to raise, it calls bus_client.reach('inference_domain') and the chart's helper skills/chart/live.py _bus (skills/, no device) and requires each to return a bus with request; the four device imports leave. Tooth (iii)'s walk over class-space already reds any client that calls connect_bus or connect_system. The module docstring's (i) says so. New proof cairn/tools/bus_client/proofs/test_bus_client_proofs_measure_only_bus_client.py carries the sieve and forbidden-module teeth.

clauses.claim: no RULE 1 breach from a file under cairn/tools/bus_client lands on a device
the never-beats proof names no module of codemother, the librarian or intention_extractor

decisions.text: D1: bus_client proves its own reach does not beat; whether a device's helper still rides reach is read by the walk, never by importing the device.
